description: Create an idempotent DB migration that seeds/replaces the two consent_page_templates rows (loaner_consent, guarantor_consent) in the chhath-templates D1 db with the user's EXACT bilingual text, register it with the migration guard tests, add a migration-content test, and verify the public Svelte consent page renders the new text without breaking the existing accept/tick/decline flow. Depends on FEAT-002 (so the new placeholder tokens the text references are emitted).
steps: Read the two verbatim template bodies from the task dir: .agents/tasks/task-loan-consent-preview-templates/template-loaner_consent.txt (=> type 'loaner_consent') and template-guarantor_consent.txt (=> type 'guarantor_consent'). Use their EXACT contents byte-for-byte: preserve section numbering, the ☐ declaration checkboxes, the emoji (⚠️ 🟢), the « » guillemets, the → arrows, every [PLACEHOLDER] and the surrounding double-quotes, and the [ ACCEPT & CONFIRM LOAN ] / [ ACCEPT CONSENT ] / [ DECLINE CONSENT ] action markers. Do NOT 'fix' the stray backtick in guarantor section 4.1 — reproduce the file as-is.

Create folder mgmt/db/migration/2026-09-18/ and file 01-loan-consent-preview-templates.sql. Model the header on mgmt/db/migration/2026-09-01/02-templates.sql and 2026-09-05/32-consent-decline-templates.sql: a comment block that (a) names the target db in the exact form the guard reads — a line containing `wrangler d1 execute chhath-templates --remote --file=./migration/2026-09-18/01-loan-consent-preview-templates.sql`; (b) explains WHY (seed the new bilingual loan consent preview text after the DB reset; idempotent so re-running is safe); (c) states it uses DELETE-then-INSERT per type so the correct current text is established regardless of prior/stale/absent rows.

SQL body (NO explicit BEGIN/COMMIT/SAVEPOINT — D1 rejects them in --file): for EACH type do `DELETE FROM consent_page_templates WHERE type = 'loaner_consent';` then `INSERT INTO consent_page_templates (type, text, updated_at) VALUES ('loaner_consent', '<escaped text>', '2026-09-18T00:00:00.000Z');` and likewise for 'guarantor_consent'. Escape every single-quote in the text as '' (there are none in the provided text bodies, but escape defensively). Keep updated_at a fixed ISO literal (NOT datetime('now')) so the file checksum is stable and the migration-matrix idempotency test that runs it TWICE produces identical rows.

Embed the multi-line text literally inside the SQL single-quoted string (SQLite allows real newlines inside string literals). Do not use char(10) concatenation — the text must round-trip exactly so substitutePlaceholders sees the real newlines that marked renders.

Register the migration in mgmt/backend/test/migration-matrix.test.mjs: add `'2026-09-18/01-loan-consent-preview-templates.sql': { schema: 'templates.sql' },` to the DECLARED object. This causes the matrix test to apply the file twice against templates.sql and assert idempotency.

Verify the target-databases guard still passes (the header's `wrangler d1 execute chhath-templates` line satisfies it) and the pr35 ledger counts are unaffected (the file is single-db + executable => kind 'runnable'; inert stays 6, multi-db stays 2, all.length grows by 1 staying >=49).

Add mgmt/backend/test/consent-templates-migration.test.mjs: load templates.sql schema into an in-memory node:sqlite DatabaseSync (use helpers/stubs.mjs schemaFor('templates.sql')), exec the migration file, then assert: (1) exactly one row per type for 'loaner_consent' and 'guarantor_consent'; (2) applying the migration a SECOND time still leaves exactly one row per type (idempotent) with identical text; (3) the loaner row text contains key headers ('LOAN RECEIPT & FINAL CONSENT', 'Final Consent Record') and a sample of required tokens ([LOANER_NAME], [LOAN_CONSENT_DATETIME], [LOAN_STATUS], [LOAN_CONSENT_ID], the ☐ checkbox, '[ ACCEPT & CONFIRM LOAN ]'); (4) the guarantor row text contains 'LOAN GUARANTOR CONSENT & TERMS AND CONDITIONS', 'Consent Record', and tokens [GUARANTOR_NAME], [CONSENT_DATETIME], [CONSENT_STATUS], [CONSENT_ID], and '[ ACCEPT CONSENT ]'/'[ DECLINE CONSENT ]'.

Sanity-check the token set: every [A-Z0-9_]+ token appearing in the two seeded texts must be one that buildConsentPlaceholders emits after FEAT-002 (add an assertion in the migration test or a small script that extracts /\[([A-Z0-9_]+)\]/g from the seeded text and checks each is a known key — this guards against a future token drift rendering as literal brackets).

Verify the public consent page: cd mgmt/frontend-svelte && npm install && npm run build must succeed (the +page.svelte substitutePlaceholders + existing accept/tick/decline UI are unchanged; confirm no code edit is needed for the longer text to render). Do NOT add a second accept/decline UI — the ☐ and [ ACCEPT ... ] markers in the document body are plain display text; the real controls are the existing checkbox + OTP + Accept/Decline buttons.
Run the full backend suite; all tests including the guard tests and the two new tests must pass with 0 failures.
acceptance_criteria: mgmt/db/migration/2026-09-18/01-loan-consent-preview-templates.sql exists, targets chhath-templates in its header, contains no BEGIN/COMMIT/SAVEPOINT, and seeds both types with the user's exact text via DELETE-then-INSERT.
migration-matrix.test.mjs DECLARED includes the new file with { schema: 'templates.sql' } and its idempotency (apply-twice) test passes.
migration-target-databases.test.mjs and pr35-migration-ledger.test.mjs still pass (counts intact: inert 6, multi-db 2).

consent-templates-migration.test.mjs passes: one row per type, idempotent on re-run, expected headers/tokens/markers present, and every bracket token in the seeded text is a placeholder the code emits.
cd mgmt/frontend-svelte && npm run build succeeds with no consent page changes required beyond the template text (no second UI added).
Full backend suite passes with 0 failures.
verification: cd mgmt/backend && export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && node --test --test-reporter=spec test/migration-matrix.test.mjs test/migration-target-databases.test.mjs test/pr35-migration-ledger.test.mjs test/consent-templates-migration.test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -14
cd mgmt/backend && export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && node --test --test-reporter=spec test/*.test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -8
cd mgmt/frontend-svelte && export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && npm install >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -12
